simple.summary: אַלַּמֶּלֶךְ (ʼAllammelek) means Allammelek , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 26.

definitions.full: H487. Allammelek אַלַּמֶּלֶךְ proper name, of a location in Asher ( = מֶלֶח אַלַּת ? so Thes MV) Josh 19:26 (Baer ׳אֲלַמּ ).
